definition: A granule cell is a neuron found in the hippocampal granule cell layer. In this context, its density is one of the features used to describe hippocampal structure and to help assess changes such as hippocampal sclerosis.

reasons: The packet supports the hippocampal granule cell layer and neuronal density measurements, but it does not explicitly support the claim that a granule cell is a neuron found in that layer.

The definition adds a general anatomical identification that is broader than the packet’s scope, which is limited to reference values for feline hippocampal cytoarchitecture and diagnostic use in hippocampal sclerosis.

The packet discusses the “granule cell layer” and measures neuronal density and layer thickness, but it does not explicitly define a “granule cell” as “a neuron found in the hippocampal granule cell layer.”

The packet supports measuring/defining reference values for granule cell layer parameters in relation to hippocampal cytoarchitecture and pathological diagnosis of hippocampal sclerosis, but it does not explicitly state that “its density is one of the features used…to help assess changes such as hippocampal sclerosis” in the general way described in the definition.
